lesson_intent.one_sentence_goal: Practice simple suggestions with ska vi and kan vi.
lesson_intent.real_life_context: Colleagues arranging lunch or a short walk.
lesson_intent.communicative_function: Making, accepting, and declining simple suggestions.

dialogue_task.scenario: Anna and Erik decide whether to take lunch, go for a short walk, or postpone the plan because one of them is busy.

main_focus.name: modal questions for suggestions
main_focus.description: Use ska vi or kan vi plus infinitive to suggest a simple shared activity.
main_focus.desired_presence: Use suggestion questions naturally 3-5 times, with clear accept or decline responses.

allowed_supporting_grammar: modal verbs: kan, ska, vill, måste

vocabulary_target.desired_presence: Use clear arrangement chunks that a learner can reuse immediately.

dialogue_shape.opening: One speaker suggests lunch or a short walk.
dialogue_shape.middle: They adjust the time or activity with one acceptance and one mild limitation.
dialogue_shape.ending: They settle on a simple plan or agree to do it later.

target_complexity.repetition: include repeated ska vi or kan vi suggestion patterns

focus: whether the other speaker can join
what time or alternative is mentioned

sentence_focus: one polite decline with kan inte
one sentence with klockan and a time
